candidates_considered.name: Pulaski County, AR
candidates_considered.rejected_because: Highest data density but metro complexity reduces interpretability as a bounded 'local' pilot

candidates_considered.name: Faulkner County, AR
candidates_considered.selected_because: Arkansas county with clear FIPS boundary; Census QuickFacts retail sales + CBP employment; mid-scale population; BEA RIMS-compatible county unit; not an LCL town; replicable to other AR counties

rims_discipline.rule: No invented local multiplier. Retail requires margin not gross sales.
rims_discipline.reason_not_applied: Faulkner County RIMS II multipliers not purchased/available in environment; applying a borrowed multiplier would manufacture precision.
rims_discipline.direct_indirect_induced: Distinguished conceptually; none quantified for Faulkner in this pilot.

retail_sales_2022.note: Economic Census aggregate retail sales — not e-commerce

transport_warehousing_receipts_2022.note: Receipts ≠ fulfillment employment attributable to e-commerce

e_commerce_hypothesis_test.can_fulfillment_offset_be_identified: NOT SEPARATELY — only aggregate transport/warehousing receipts
e_commerce_hypothesis_test.what_tax_revenue_remains_locally: LEGAL OBLIGATION YES; ATTRIBUTABLE AMOUNT NOT ISOLATED
e_commerce_hypothesis_test.wayfair_alter_tax_effects: YES — AR Act 822 / DFA remote seller rules (CC-SRC-102)
e_commerce_hypothesis_test.consumer_surplus_benefits: NATIONAL LITERATURE YES (CC-SRC-098); COUNTY TRANSFER PROXY ONLY
e_commerce_hypothesis_test.rural_product_access: MIXED — national study finds denser counties gained more
e_commerce_hypothesis_test.local_businesses_export_via_platforms: PLAUSIBLE — UNAVAILABLE in public county data
e_commerce_hypothesis_test.net_finding_explanation: Public data establish retail scale and tax-law environment for Faulkner County but do not permit a defensible net e-commerce leakage estimate after required netting (margins, logistics, surplus, remittance, ownership).

component_results.LEAK-COMP-01: METHOD_READY — multipliers UNAVAILABLE; gross sales must not be treated as leakage
component_results.LEAK-COMP-02: PROXY_ONLY — transport/warehousing receipts observable; e-commerce attribution unidentified
component_results.LEAK-COMP-04: LEGAL_FRAMEWORK_OBSERVABLE — remittance attribution ESTIMABLE later via DFA NAICS extracts

honest_bottom_line: Current public data do not permit a defensible net local e-commerce leakage estimate for Faulkner County. That is a research finding, not a failure of the pilot.
